text.en:
Scoring 3 Melee Attack kills within 5 seconds of each grants 2 ammo.

Passively grants: 
• 2 Impact (~1.2% increased damage)
• 10 Charge Rate 
• 40 Guard Resistance
• 40 Guard Endurance

Scoring 3 Melee Attack kills within 5 seconds of each grants 1 ammo.

Passively grants: 
• 2 Impact (~1.2% increased damage)
• 10 Charge Rate 
• 40 Guard Resistance
• 40 Guard Endurance
